scenes.line: Twenty years ago, this district was officially "backward." Today it's India's richest.
In 2006, Ranga Reddy was on India's list of the 250 most backward districts.
It's the district right next to Hyderabad. Here's what it looks like now.
Income per person: eleven point three lakh. Number one in Telangana.
That's five times the Indian average of two point two lakh.
Telangana as a whole went from 1.24 lakh to 4.19 lakh since 2014.
The engine? IT. 3.13 lakh crore in exports, 9.39 lakh people in IT jobs, 1,500-plus companies.
And pharma: 5.9 billion dollars in exports. Nineteen percent of India's.
ISB, IIIT, the airport, all inside this one district.
So where's Hyderabad's next money spot? Kokapet, Future City, Shamshabad, or your area? Tell me below.
